description: This file defines a mock class ServiceMock for testing, which implements multiple interfaces including WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell and its nested ICOMLink. It uses Google Mock to create mock methods for various functions related to a service in a plugin framework.

classes.name: ServiceMock
